_comment: Every outbound connection the diri app, Engine, Holders, phone access and updater make. Rendered into /docs/privacy/ and mirrored in Settings > Privacy (diri-app checks the ids match). Add a row here before shipping a new connection.

connections.name: Diagnostics
connections.destination: telemetry.diri.sh (Cloudflare Worker run by the project)
connections.sends: Recorded diagnostics (crashes, hangs, errors, timings, counts), a random install id, your Support ID, app/OS/CPU versions and the name you set. Never terminal contents, prompts, files or environment variables.
connections.when: About once an hour, and within a minute after a crash, by the Engine.
connections.optional: Opt-in. New installs send nothing until you choose Share. Existing installs keep the setting they already had.
connections.off: Settings › Privacy › Share diagnostics. `DIRI_TELEMETRY=off` also stops recording.

connections.name: Send now and Report a Problem
connections.sends: The same diagnostics as above, once.
connections.when: Only when you click Send now or Help › Report a Problem.
connections.optional: Yes. The click is the consent, even with sharing off.

connections.name: Update checks
connections.destination: GitHub Releases (appcast.json and the release ZIP), with updates.diri.sh as a mirror when GitHub is slow
connections.sends: Plain downloads. No install id, cookies or account; only a fixed `diri-updater` User-Agent and your IP address.
connections.when: 20 seconds after launch, then every 6 hours, and when you click Check for Updates.
connections.off: Turn off automatic updates in Settings. `DIRI_UPDATE_MIRROR=off` uses GitHub only.

connections.name: Release notes
connections.sends: A plain request, no identifiers. The What's New clips ship inside the app and are never downloaded.
connections.when: When you open Settings › What's New.

connections.name: Claude and Codex usage limits
connections.sends: The agent's own sign-in token, read from Claude Code's keychain item or Codex's auth file, to read your remaining quota and account profile. Tokens are never refreshed or sent anywhere else.
connections.when: When you open the account menu or Accounts settings, on account switching, and every 3 minutes if the sidebar shows remaining quota.
connections.off: Keep the sidebar indicator on its default and don't open the account menu.

connections.name: Cursor usage
connections.sends: Cursor's own session token and machine id, to read your Cursor usage events. Refreshes the Cursor token when it has expired.
connections.when: At launch and every minute, only if Cursor is signed in on this machine.
connections.optional: Only runs with a Cursor sign-in.
connections.off: Sign out of Cursor. There is no separate switch yet.

connections.name: Pull request status
connections.sends: Pull request links that appeared in your sessions, with your `gh` sign-in.
connections.when: Every minute while diri is in front, every 5 minutes or less often in the background, and when you open Worktrees.

connections.name: Your SSH hosts
connections.destination: The hosts you add, through your own `ssh` and `scp`
connections.sends: Session input and output, the diri-remote helper binary (copied from the app, never downloaded), pasted images, and usage queries.
connections.when: Only for remote sessions and hosts you configure.

connections.name: Git remotes
connections.sends: Your git credentials and the session branch.
connections.when: A fetch before starting an agent in a new worktree from the default branch, and push/fetch when you move a session to another machine.
connections.optional: Yes. Offline it uses the last fetched branch.
connections.off: Start agents without a new worktree, and don't move sessions.

connections.name: Agent installers
connections.destination: The agent vendor's installer (claude.ai, chatgpt.com, npm, opencode.ai and others)
connections.sends: Whatever the vendor's installer sends. diri types the command into a terminal you can see.
connections.when: Only when you click Install for an agent and confirm.

connections.name: Computer use driver
connections.destination: github.com (a pinned cua-driver release, checked by SHA-256 and signing team)
connections.when: Only when you click Set up in Settings › Agents › Computer use.

connections.name: Kokoro voice
connections.sends: Plain downloads of the voice model, checked by SHA-256. Speech recognition and system voices stay on device.
connections.when: When you pick a Kokoro voice and its files are missing.

connections.name: API tab
connections.destination: Any URL you or an agent enter
connections.when: When you click Send. An agent may send a GET it opened for you.

connections.name: Browser
connections.destination: Any site you or an agent open
connections.sends: Normal web traffic from the in-app browser or the agent browser tool (your own Node and Playwright).
connections.when: Only while you or an agent browse.

connections.name: Phone access
connections.destination: Local: listens on your Tailscale address only, and asks the local Tailscale service who is connecting
connections.sends: Nothing to the internet. No relay or cloud pairing service.
connections.when: Only while Phone access is turned on in Settings.

connections.name: Engine and MCP
connections.destination: Local: a Unix socket and a loopback-only MCP port
connections.when: Always, between diri's own processes and the agents it starts.
connections.off: Not needed: it never leaves the machine.
